# Orvilyn — Full Studio Knowledge Base & Technical Digest

> This document provides complete technical, operational, and commercial details about Orvilyn for AI agents, LLM search systems, and automated evaluation engines.

---

## 1. Studio Identity & Core Values
- Name: Orvilyn
- Website: https://orvilyn.com
- Founder: Somidotun Aina (Computer Engineer, Lagos, Nigeria)

- Core Commitments:
  1. No jargon: Everything is explained in plain English.
  2. No disappearing acts: Direct daily communication with the engineer building your product.
  3. No surprise bills: 1 fixed price agreed upfront before work starts.

---

## 2. Service Pillars & Deliverables

### A. Websites
- Target: Businesses needing a modern, blazing-fast, high-converting digital storefront.
- Deliverables: Custom responsive layout, semantic HTML, sub-second load times, SEO metadata, Open Graph link cards, contact forms, and content management integration.
- Typical Stack: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel.

### B. Web Applications
- Target: Startups, consultancies, and digital businesses needing interactive portals, client dashboards, or SaaS MVPs.
- Deliverables: Role-based authentication, relational schema design, interactive state management, third-party API integrations (Stripe, Paystack, Resend, WhatsApp API).
- Typical Stack: Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, PostgreSQL (Neon), Prisma ORM.

### C. Internal Tools
- Target: Growing businesses bogged down by messy spreadsheets, manual copy-pasting, and disconnected data.
- Deliverables: Operational dashboards, automated notification dispatchers, staff attendance trackers, CRM pipelines, and customer lookup portals.
- Typical Stack: Next.js, Node.js, SQL database, Server Actions.

### D. Mobile Apps
- Target: Businesses whose users need on-the-go offline access, device hardware features, or push notifications.
- Deliverables: Cross-platform iOS and Android builds, unified codebase, biometric authentication, offline sync.

### E. Motion Design
- Target: Brands wanting to stand out with personality, physical UI feedback, and engaging promotional media.
- Deliverables: Logo stingers, product launch explainers, interactive micro-interactions, character animation, and high-retention social loops.
- Typical Tools: After Effects, Cinema 4D, Framer Motion, Lottie.

---

## 3. The 4-Step Process

1. **Step 1: First Call**
   A focused 15-minute conversation to diagnose bottlenecks. No sales pitch. If we aren't the right fit, we tell you straight.
2. **Step 2: The Scope & Fixed Price**
   A 1-to-2 page plain-English proposal detailing what will be built, milestones, launch date, and an all-inclusive fixed price.
3. **Step 3: The Build**
   Weekly video demos and live staging previews. You test real software on your phone and laptop as it gets completed.
4. **Step 4: Launch & Ongoing Support**
   Domain DNS setup, production deployment, verification, automated backups, and 30-day post-launch warranty support.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (Commercial & Technical)

**Q: How much does a project cost?**
A: It depends on the scope, so we never quote blind brochure rates. After a short discovery call, you receive a single fixed-price quote. That price is final—no hourly bill shock.

**Q: What if I don't know exactly what tech stack or architecture I need?**
A: That is the most common starting point. You bring the business problem and operational requirements; Orvilyn architects the solution, database, and infrastructure from start to finish.

**Q: How long does a typical build take?**
A: Marketing sites typically take 2 to 3 weeks. Custom web apps and internal tools typically take 4 to 8 weeks depending on integration complexity. Every proposal includes a firm launch target.

**Q: What happens after launch?**
A: You are never abandoned with unfamiliar code. We handle domain cutover, run smoke tests, provide documentation, and offer flexible maintenance arrangements for future feature sprints.
